issues: Both scenes were flat full-bleed screenshots and the fade was a plain full-frame dip to black, with no stage or light
The 96px centred title wrapped into a line and a half, leaving one orphan word on line two
The 28px mono subline was unreadable and the black frame was mostly empty with no visual anchor
Even rhythm: fade-out, imprint, exit and fade-in were all the same soft dissolve, with no lights-down ceremony
changes: Warm ember cinema look: both scenes are product windows (real screenshot textures) floating on a warm black stage under a top key light
The dip to black is now a lights-down: the key light dims and the window darkens bottom-up while the camera keeps a 4% inertial push; the next scene is lit back up and settles from 1.05 to 1

The card is a left-aligned film chapter layout: CHAPTER 02 kicker plus a 132px two-line headline imprinted word by word (1.16x/10px blur to sharp, dense then loose), key words in an amber-to-orange gradient
A giant outlined 02 is traced in amber on the right and a four-part chapter bar lights up chapter 2, anchoring the empty dark frame
140f timeline: 18f lights-down, 24f imprint, 30f full-card hold with a 1.5% creep, blurred rise-out, 18f lights-up, then B hold
